'''Defensive Shields''' is a Players Committee sheet of 18 printable Defensive Shield slips from the [[:Category:Virtual Original sets|Virtual Original]] era, with official text as of 4 December 2006. Each slip is cut out and sleeved with the matching Decipher Defensive Shield. Its cover title is '''Virtual Set: Defensive Shields''', and star-wars.pl calls it Premium Set 1.<ref name="pdf">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071028141121/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/DefensiveShields.pdf DefensiveShields.pdf], swccgpc.com Resources; cover title Virtual Set: Defensive Shields; Official text as of December 4, 2006; footer SWCCG Player's Committee 2006 (Internet Archive, 28 October 2007).</ref><ref name="plsets">[https://star-wars.pl/Tekst/1963,Star_Wars_CCG_Virtual_Sets.html Star Wars CCG Virtual Sets], star-wars.pl</ref>

The sheet belongs to [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]; see also [[History of the Players Committee]]. Its icon shorthand is explained at [[Virtual card icons]]. It is distinct from [[Virtual Shields]] (later Block / Legacy packaging of the shield pool), [[Virtual Set D]] (the current shields set) and Shields-Decipher.pdf (Decipher Reflections shields).

== Launch vs later update ==

star-wars.pl places the set between Virtual Sets 11 and 12.<ref name="plsets" /> Its official text date, 4 December 2006, matches Virtual Set 11's; Virtual Set 12's is 9 January 2007.

The swccgpc.com Downloads catalog listed the sheet (lid=33) as "Official text as of August 23, 2006".<ref name="catalog">swccgpc.com Downloads catalog, lid=33, Internet Archive capture of about 24 October 2007.</ref> The Resources PDF is a 4 December 2006 refresh, made the same day as the VirtualCards1.pdf Legacy sheet.<ref name="pdf" />

An even older black-on-white printing of Defensive Shields circulated by private message only.<ref name="forum22434">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=22434 forum.starwarsccg.org t=22434]</ref>

== ICON KEY ==

The sheet prints the same ICON KEY wording as the December 2006 Legacy VS1 sheet (Immune to Alter / Control / Sense; pilot-power X; maintenance; grabber; triangle shorthands). [[Virtual card icons]] quotes the legend.<ref name="pdf" />

[[File:PS1-DefensiveShields-icon-key.png|640px]]

== Slip sheet gallery ==

Page 2 of the sheet holds the 18 numbered slips.<ref name="pdf" />

[[File:PS1-DefensiveShields-slips-sheet.png|720px]]

== Card list ==

Titles, numbers and sides follow the sheet and the matching Decipher Defensive Shields. Slip images are cropped from page 2, and each card page transcribes its game text from the sheet.<ref name="pdf" />
